description: Change the title, description, visibility, site placement (show_on_site) or paid access of a video in the connected account. A PRIVATE or LINK_ONLY video is never shown on the site. is_paid and price (USD) put the video behind a paywall that the DCAST player runs; this needs a payout gateway connected by the user in the DCAST cabinet, otherwise the answer is NO_PAYOUT_GATEWAY. A price outside get_account saleBounds: 400 PRICE_BELOW_PLAN_MIN or PRICE_ABOVE_PLAN_MAX. Confirm price changes with the user.

is_paid.description: true makes the video paid, false makes it free (price is cleared)

price.description: Price in USD; null clears it

show_on_site.description: Show on the creator site; never for PRIVATE or LINK_ONLY

visibility.description: PUBLIC (listed), LINK_ONLY (by link, not listed) or PRIVATE (owner only)

name: update_video
title: Update video details
